source.scope: Current task; parent relayed the user update on 2026-11-21
source.paraphrase_zh: 正常 BLE 完整帧缺口约 2.5% 可接受；弱链路允许约 10–20%，更弱降低输出。关键控制、配置切换后首个完整帧、周期完整快照优先。
source.paraphrase_en: Approximately 2.5% missing complete BLE frames is acceptable in normal operation; weak links may tolerate about 10–20%, with reduced output on weaker links. Prioritize critical control, the first complete frame after a configuration change and periodic complete snapshots.

normal_link.metric: missing trusted complete-frame sequence observations / (received ordered trusted complete frames + missing observations)
normal_link.window: within one session and immutable configuration identity, using the BLE observation endpoints
normal_link.rf_quality_classification: not inferred from the numeric gap ratio

weak_link.weaker_link_action: reduce routine output; acquisition remains independent

requirements: first complete frame of the applied configuration
priorities.snapshot_period_origin: implementation default selected by the lead agent; user requested periodic snapshots without fixing the interval
priorities.snapshot_validity: complete active-row payload retains original invalid/Xhh points; complete does not mean all points valid
priorities.delivery_guarantee: priority is not exactly-once, SDK cancellation or confirmed PC receipt

accounting_domains.intentional_output_decimation: An explicit policy chooses fewer routine DATA frames while preserving acquisition. Report it separately; it still appears as sequence skips against all capture frames unless a same-window eligible-output denominator is defined and supported by telemetry.
accounting_domains.local_admission_rejection: Queue pressure, quarantine or policy rejects a local record. Counts are layer scoped, not measured radio loss, and must not be added to host gaps as independent losses.
accounting_domains.pc_complete_frame_gap: The host lacks a CRC-and-identity-valid complete-frame observation within defined endpoints. This is not a proven packet-level air loss or literal absence of all bytes.
accounting_domains.adc_spi_crc: Checked ADC read rejection is a separate scientific integrity metric. The existing 0.025 startup qualification limit is unchanged by this transport acceptance update; rejected samples remain invalid or follow existing bounded retry.

historical_evidence_policy: Original recordings, analysis and FAIL verdict JSON remain immutable. New criteria are applied only in a new supplemental assessment.
